title: My appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to Deny your appeal due the lack of effort that was put into this appeal.

It does not matter if the account was only logged in for "5 seconds". The account last logged in with the same ip of a temp-banned/banned user.

I find it hard to believe that this was an accident. You've been on this server for a while now and should by now know the rules.  

Regards,
Kaliks12, Senior Mod
